entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Amit Kumar Awasthi,Ashish Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.106 of 2023, under Section 498A, 304B, 323,
504 IPC & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Nighasan, District Kheri.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the sister of the informant was married to the applicant and sufficient dowry was given.
Subsequently, on 20.02.2023, it was informed that the entire matrimonial family had killed her.

Learned counsel for the applicant draws my attention to the post-mortem report which records the cause of death as ante mortem hanging and apart from the Kallu Alias Shiv Prakash vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Kallu Alias Shiv Prakash vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: ligature mark, no other injury is seen over the body of the victim.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant has filed a supplementary affidavit disclosing that the informant had turned hostile and has not supported the prosecution story and all the other co-accused have been enlarged on bail.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the fact that the informant himself has not supported the prosecution story coupled with the fact that there is no material that soon before the death, the victim was subjected to any physical or mental harassment in relation to dowry, a case for bail is made out, particularly, when the applicant is in custody since 06.03.2023 and has no criminal antecedent, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Kallu Alias Shiv Prakash be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.1.2024 nishant  Kallu Alias Shiv Prakash vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
